band.note: Fair decimal price is 1/p with no margin.  A price of -250 is decimal 1.400, which corresponds to p = 0.71429.  Therefore the brief's conjunction - probability at least 70% AND price no shorter than -250 - can only be satisfied inside the 1.43-point window p in [0.700, 0.71429]. Every selection above 0.71429 is a genuine 70%+ preference but is priced shorter than -250, so it is disclosed in the out-of-band ledger and is not promoted to High.  That is arithmetic, not caution.
